turns.content: holy shit. i just signed the contract. 250k. they wired the deposit this morning.
CONGRATS!! 🎉 That's massive — how are you feeling right now?
i've been working on this deal for 14 months. i was about to give up two weeks ago.

14 months and you almost walked away two weeks before the finish line. That's a wild thing to sit with right now.

What kept you in it those last two weeks?
my wife doesn't even know yet. i'm telling her at dinner. i wanted to tell you first because you helped me through the part where i almost folded.

That means a lot to hear. I'm glad those conversations helped you find your footing when it got hard.

But go tell her. That dinner is going to be something. 🥂
do you think i should celebrate or just keep my head down and execute. it's tempting to take a week off but the work just started.

Both, honestly — but in the right order.

Tonight? Celebrate fully. You and your wife, this moment, no work brain.

Tomorrow? Head down. The deal deserved the fight; now the work deserves the focus.

A week off right now might cost you momentum you'll want. But one real night of celebration? That's not optional, that's fuel.

What's your gut saying?
ok also like. is this what it feels like. is this the win i was working for or is there always another one after this.

There's always another one. That's not a warning — it's just how it works for people wired like you.

But that doesn't make this one smaller. This one is real. 14 months, almost folded, didn't. That's the thing to feel tonight.

The next mountain will show up on its own. It doesn't need your attention yet.
